title: Event Cover · Night Out
description: Thumbnail of the event page in the Webflow CMS (1200×900) (Night Out content block)
useWhen: an event page, Luma or email invite needs a header image.
notWhen: the piece is a social post or a day-before reminder. Pick the cover that matches the social template of the same campaign (the table below); when the event has no social template yet, choose by content: a booth, a speaker, or a hosted evening.
guidance: Dates follow the house style: "March 12 – 14, 2026". Kickers and event names in title case (the design sets uppercase where needed).
Images (city or venue photo, speaker portrait) and partner or offer logos: an https link from the requester, or an approved asset. Never generate a person or a venue; a city photo may be left out.
Leave out any fact that does not exist (booth, venue, time): its label goes with it and the layout closes up.
